content.value_statement: Codebases can hide design choices that raise maintenance risk. This skill identifies common patterns, anti-patterns, and practical refactoring recommendations.
actual_capabilities: Identifies Singleton, Factory, Observer, Strategy, and other common design patterns.
Detects anti-patterns such as God Object, Spaghetti Code, Magic Numbers, and Cargo Cult Programming.
Evaluates whether a detected pattern fits the code purpose and implementation quality.
Produces a structured pattern detection report with locations, notes, severity, and recommendations.
Suggests refactoring options, simpler alternatives, and pattern trade-offs.
limitations: Requires code context from the user or repository to produce useful results.
Focuses on common documented patterns and does not cover every architecture style.
Recommendations require human review before large refactors are started.
Does not automatically modify code or run tests.

use_cases.title: Review a Legacy Module
use_cases.description: Find maintainability risks and pattern misuse before a refactor plan is created.

use_cases.title: Coach Junior Developers
use_cases.description: Explain which patterns are present and why simpler alternatives may be better.

use_cases.title: Prepare Architecture Feedback
use_cases.description: Summarize pattern usage, anti-pattern severity, and recommended next steps for review.

prompt_templates.title: Scan One File
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of a single source file.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use pattern-detector on this file. List any design patterns, anti-patterns, and simple recommendations.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Pattern Fit
prompt_templates.prompt: Use pattern-detector to evaluate whether the patterns in this module fit the business problem. Suggest simpler alternatives where needed.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Refactor
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced maintenance planning for a risky module.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use pattern-detector to identify high-impact anti-patterns and propose a staged refactor plan with trade-offs.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a Codebase
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced architecture review across multiple files.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use pattern-detector across this repository. Group findings by pattern type, severity, affected area, and recommended owner action.

output_examples.input: A service module with one shared instance and many unrelated responsibilities.
output: Detected Singleton usage with hidden dependencies.
Detected God Object risk because one service owns authentication, storage, and notifications.
Recommended splitting responsibilities and using dependency injection.

output_examples.input: An order processing workflow with deeply nested discounts and shipping conditions.
output: Detected Spaghetti Code risk from nested branching and mixed concerns.
Suggested extracting pricing and shipping logic into focused functions.
Recommended considering Strategy only if pricing rules vary at runtime.

output_examples.input: A data access layer with direct database calls spread across feature modules.
output: Recommended Repository pattern to centralize persistence logic.
Noted improved testability through dependency injection.
Flagged over-engineering risk if the application has only one simple data source.

best_practices: Provide representative files or folders so pattern findings have enough context.
Ask for severity and trade-offs when using the report for refactor planning.
Review recommendations against product constraints before changing architecture.
anti_patterns: Do not treat every named pattern as a required improvement.
Do not request a full-codebase judgment from a single small snippet.
Do not apply refactoring advice without tests or reviewer agreement.

faq.question: Does this skill change my code?
faq.answer: No. It provides analysis and recommendations only.

faq.question: Which patterns can it identify?
faq.answer: It covers common creational, structural, behavioral, and architectural patterns listed in the skill instructions.

faq.question: Can it find anti-patterns?
faq.answer: Yes. It looks for issues such as God Object, Spaghetti Code, Lava Flow, Magic Numbers, and over-engineering.

faq.question: Can Claude, Codex, and Claude Code use it?
faq.answer: Yes. The report declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Is it a replacement for architecture review?
faq.answer: No. It prepares findings and recommendations for human review.

faq.question: What input works best?
faq.answer: Complete modules, related folders, or focused files with their purpose produce the clearest results.
